question: How sensitive are the frozen S4 baseline-adjusted relative RNA contrasts to the two observed baseline-profile references?
decision: Retain primary and both one-library-per-history references side by side; narrow interpretation where reference choice changes continuous magnitudes or directions, then return for coordinator review before S3/S5/S6.
strongest_rival: Observed baseline Xist/Y-marker heterogeneity despite recorded female metadata may accompany unresolved preparation/composition differences. Profile-aligned references do not establish biological sex, matching or correction; each alternative has only one library per history.
discriminator: Change only the baseline reference while keeping the frozen S4 normalized values, wound means, qualification and examples fixed. Compare primary two-library/group means with GSM2440992/2440990 and GSM2440991/2440989. This isolates numerical reference dependence but cannot identify its cause.
exposure_record: All S4 results, marker profiles and selected examples were viewed and coordinator-reviewed before this specification. These reference choices are explicitly outcome-exposed. Small artificial fixtures test implementation; no real S4B contrast was calculated before freeze, and a later freeze does not erase source exposure.
biological_unit: Frozen S4 deposited libraries. Primary baseline has two libraries per history; each alternative has one. Source-reported pooled preparations remain positive design evidence; exact membership, overlap and matching are unknown.
nesting_and_overlap: The same S4 dataset and post-wound means are reused; genes are features. The alternative-minus-primary adjusted shift is identical at W6/W12 by arithmetic, not independent time replication. No matched animals or biological strata are inferred.
population_and_selection: All 47729 frozen S4 genes, original phase-specific baseline/wound expression unions and intersections, and the same six selected examples. No alternative-reference refiltering, exclusion or new winner selection.
contrast: L0_r = log2((frozen baseline history library+1)/(frozen baseline control library+1)); A_t,r = frozen wound H/C log2 effect minus L0_r. Retain original two-library/group baseline and adjustments. Alternative-minus-primary shift = L0_primary-L0_r at both wound times.
endpoint: Continuous finite-library relative RNA reference sensitivity, effect/sign changes and low/zero flags on frozen MOR and total-count scales; unregularized values only when defined. No population inference, kinetics, repair, sex assignment or source correction.
methods: No normalization refit or raw download. Read frozen S4 values and effects. Compute both alternative baselines and W6/W12 adjustments for MOR, total-count and defined unregularized MOR. Computational tie tolerance 1e-10; flag reference zero and MOR below one. Summarize all genes and original comparison unions/baseline intersections with continuous signed/absolute quantiles, primary/alternative and MOR/total sign changes. Keep the original six examples and one four-panel PNG/PDF. Independent stdlib arithmetic verifies all fields, reference identities, copied qualification, fixed selection, fractions and quantiles.
missingness_and_exclusions: All genes and references retained. Undefined unregularized ratios or adjustments are NA. Zero/low values flagged rather than excluded. Original source female labels retained; no sex inference, matching or preferred replacement.
multiplicity: No inferential tests or biological stability margin. Gene-wise distributions summarize features, not independent biological replicates. Previously selected examples remain exposed illustrations.
precision_basis: One-library alternative references give no sampling-variance estimate. No CI, equivalence threshold or power claim; 1e-10 is computational tolerance only.
interpretation_limit: Sensitivity to baseline reference narrows the relative-RNA interpretation only. Stability would not resolve sex/provenance, pooled units, compartment or preparation confounding. Identical time shifts arise by construction. No alternative is selected as a correction or independent evidence of intrinsic memory or repair.
stop_rule: Require frozen committed contract/code and matched S4 input hashes. Fail on gene/order/qualification/selection mismatch, nonfinite regularized effects or independent-verification failure. Preserve failed real runs and use a new version for changes. Finish/register/commit S4B and return for review before S3/S5/S6. Do not retry held broad source extraction or change safeguards.
amendment_reason: New authorized, exposed baseline-reference sensitivity after reviewed S4; preserves every S4 artifact and does not replace its primary analysis.
